messages:
Adele: Quick note 1: full site build started failing on CI after merging the i18n restructure. Lots of broken fragment links in sidebar-generated pages.
Raj: I noticed that too. Docusaurus and MkDocs generate slightly different slug styles which is blowing up cross-repo links (examples -> examples-1 vs examples_1).
Niamh: can we make the site generator normalize both? or should we prefer redirects in the webserver?
Jordan: short-term: I pushed a tiny middleware that rewrites incoming fragment anchors to try both slug styles before returning 404. low-risk.
Adele: good short-term fix. long term I'd prefer canonicalization in the docs source so repo-level links are stable.
Raj: agreed. I'm starting a script to scan markdown for anchors that contain non-ascii or punctuation and print the two variants (docusaurus/mkdocs). example: `./tools/anchor-scan --format mkdocs,docusaurus`
Niamh: please add an opt-in autofix mode that writes suggested canonical anchors as `{:#canonical}` after headers so authors can review.
Raj: will do. also discovered a handful of autogenerated example files that include duplicate headings (sidebar auto-fold), we need to dedupe headings in the generator.
Adele: for the deploy pipeline, can we make linkcheck non-blocking for now but report new failures as alerts? we don't want to block all merges.
docs-bot: linkcheck status: 2026-03-23T09:12:00Z  12 warnings, 7 errors.
Jordan: updated staging proxy with anchor-fallback middleware. deploy-bot: staging deploy 2026-03-23T09:18:42Z: successful.
deploy-bot: note: linkcheck still run as GitHub Action but marked as neutral for merge gating.
Niamh: I opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612 - includes anchor-scan tool, autofix flag, and a small md preprocessor to emit canonical anchors. tests included.
Raj: reviewing now. one request: emit an `anchor-map.json` artifact so linkcheck can consume it and suggest remaps instead of hard-fail.
Adele: yes please. also add a short entry to docs/CONTRIBUTING.md: "If you add headings with punctuation, run `./tools/anchor-scan` to see canonical slug variants." keeps churn low.
Niamh: added the CONTRIBUTING note and the anchor-map output. CI now produces anchor-map.json as artifact.
docs-bot: GH action linkcheck on PR 612: now uses anchor-map.json to rewrite links. result: 0 new errors, 3 remapped warnings.
Adele: excellent. after merge let's run a one-off job to patch the top 50 affected pages with canonical anchors (autofix) and notify content owners.
Jordan: I'll schedule that for Sunday low-traffic window.
Raj: post-merge follow-up: add a small e2e that builds with both mkdocs and docusaurus slug rules to catch regressions.
Adele: thanks team. small wins. :sparkles:
